sloka: स दर्भ चमस स्रुक्का स समित् कुसुमोच्चया ।विश्वामित्रेण सहिता वेदिः जज्वाल स ऋत्विजा ॥१-३०-९॥
transliteration: sa darbha camasa srukkā sa samit kusumoccayā ।viśvāmitreṇa sahitā vediḥ jajvāla sa ṛtvijā ॥1-30-9॥

translations.english: The altar with Viswamitra and the officiating priests, kusa grass, ladles and square vessels, bundles of sticks and flowers, (used in the sacrificfial fire) got brightened up.
